description: This file defines the 'Article' class as part of the domain model in an ASP.NET Core application. It models the properties and relationships of an article entity, including metadata, author, comments, tags, and favorite status.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: A domain model representing an article with properties for content, author, tags, comments, and favoriting status.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: A boolean property indicating whether the article has been favorited by any users.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: An integer property indicating the number of users who have favorited the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: A list of tag names associated with the article, derived from 'ArticleTags'.
